warnings: This house's structural plan is a single small rectangle (grid 1-3 x A-E) plus one appendage room south of grid E carrying an accessible ramp (per S-01 notes, §3.1 ฐานรากทางลาด คสล.) — dummy line E' and 1' exist to give that ramp's footings/beam (F0.80x0.80 C0 x2, beam B1) a resolvable grid_ref, per the beam-endpoint rule.

The 7.50m(x)/12.00m(y) dimension chain (1-2:4.00, 2-3:3.50, A-B:3.00, B-C:3.00, C-D:4.00, D-E:2.00) is printed identically on S-02, S-03, S-04, S-05 and S-06 — recorded once here (source S-02/S-03) rather than once per sheet, to keep this file a reasonable size; not re-verified digit-by-digit on every repeat sheet.

REVERSED 2026-08-28. This warning previously read: "z_levels[] is empty: no explicit '+X.XX' level value was found printed anywhere in the S-01..S-14 structural set actually extracted for op04 (footing sections reference 'ระดับที่กำหนด' -- a site-determined design level -- with no number attached; the architectural/elevation sheets that would normally carry ±0.00/+0.60 etc. are A-series and out of op04's scope)." That reading was correct about the S-series and wrong about the building: A-08 (หน้า10, 'รูปตัด A-A / รูปตัด B-B') prints the whole z axis with Thai labels -- ระดับอ้างอิง ±0.00, ระดับพื้นชั้นล่าง +0.31, ระดับหลังคานหลังคา +3.30, ระดับหลังอกไก่ +5.95 (main) and +4.60 (east ramp wing) -- plus the closing chain 0.31 + 2.99 + 2.65 = 5.95. The sheet was opened outside op04's scope on Makham's 2026-08-28 instruction to go and get the z axis wherever it is printed. The same sheet also independently confirms this master's plan axes (รูปตัด A-A: 4.00 / 3.50 = 7.50 over grids 1-2-3; รูปตัด B-B: 3.00 / 3.00 / 4.00 / 2.00 = 12.00 over A-B-C-D-E). The footing sections' 'ระดับที่กำหนด' with no number remains true and unchanged. unassigned_dimensions[] still un-swept.

House title block reads 'บ้านผู้สูงวัย (ขนาดใหญ่)' (elderly-accessible house, large) — a different series from the 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย' houses 01-05, standard design STD-S-65023 from กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง, dated 29 กันยายน 2565. Structure is hybrid: RC columns C0/C1 (0.20x0.20, 4-Ø12mm, per S-07/S-13/S-14 schedules) at floor level, plus light steel columns 'CS' (C-150x100x3.2mm) and a full steel roof frame (ridge/rafters/purlins, per S-06) at eave/roof level.

TOC (S-01, printed page 17) lists S-10 as beam details B1-B4 and S-11 as B4A-B6X separately, and S-12 as slab details — but the sheets actually printed in the set combine ALL beam details (B1 through B6X) onto one sheet titled 'S-10' (มี 2 บรรทัดชื่อเรื่อง: แบบขยายคาน B1,B2,B3,B4 + แบบขยายคาน B4A,B4B,B5,B6,B6X), and the slab details appear on the sheet titled 'S-11'. Followed the printed sheet_code on each actual sheet (source of truth), not the TOC's outline — flagging the mismatch here rather than guessing which is 'right'.

No soil_boring_log sheet in this set (op04 subtask absent), and no dedicated plan_column sheet — columns appear only as marks on the footing plans (S-02/S-03) and in the column schedule (S-07), per op04's own note that this is the expected/common case.
